failure_summary.description: Each trajectory called a search or filter without assigning and saving its result to the cache.
A new restaurant budget criterion was searched from scratch instead of filtering compatible cached restaurant results.

patch.reasoning: The skill already asks agents to save results and reuse compatible cache entries, but these trajectories show that the instructions need a clearer, executable workflow. Make assignment and saving an explicit part of every search or transformation, and spell out how to retrieve and filter cached results when criteria are added.

edits.target: - On each turn, consider the full conversation and cached result summaries. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match the request. If the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the matching filter, and save the updated result. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cached results do not cover. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints in filters that were already applied. Save each newly generated search or transformation result under a unique cache key. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.
edits.content: - On each turn, consider the full conversation and cached result summaries. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match the request. When adding criteria to a compatible cached result, retrieve it with `get_results_from_cache(key="...")`, assign the return value, pass it as `prior_results` to the matching filter, and save the filtered result under a unique cache key. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cache does not cover. For every new search or transformation—including filters, sorts, and nearest-result calls—assign its return value and call `save_to_cache` with that value under a unique key; do not omit this call. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints already applied. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.
